items.title: DeMeco Ryans taking back defensive play-calling for Texans

items.title: Malik Nabers spoke to John Harbaugh about "trying to give me the ball down the field"
items.text: Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers had his most productive day of the season in last Sunday's win over the Cardinals, but he said on Wednesday that he feels "like that was a basic game" rather than a breakthrough as he continues working his way back from last season's torn ACL.

items.title: Titans fire three executives, including the V.P. who oversaw the uniform change
items.text: The Titans changed their logos and uniforms this year, and now they're making changes in their front office — including firing the executive who oversaw the uniform changes.

items.title: Lane Johnson's retirement could create a cap mess for the Eagles in 2027

items.title: Through four weeks of the season, zero kickoff return touchdowns

items.title: 49ers DE Mykel Williams: "Losing my mind" with excitement for return to lineup

items.title: Cowboys will "move pieces around" in field goal protection after blocks two weeks in a row
